_register: Formal polite « вы » (lowercase, never « ты », never capital « Вы ») in sentences addressed to the reader; buttons, menu entries and step lists use the infinitive or the noun, as Russian software does (Выдать, Сохранить, Сканировать штрихкод; menu: Выдача, Возврат); impersonal wording is preferred to addressing the reader; no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Russian guillemets « text » with no space inside them; nested quotes use „ “ (e.g. « Выдано: „…“ »); no space before : ; ? ! , but a non-breaking space (U+00A0) before the long dash — and between a number and its unit or noun where a line break would hurt; the decimal separator is the comma; dates are DD.MM.YYYY; the arrow → stays; use « е » rather than « ё » where the text does not need it, but keep « ё » where it distinguishes words (всё, учёт).
_plural: Russian has four plural forms: one (1, 21, 31…), few (2-4, 22-24…), many (0, 5-20, 25-30…) and other (fractions); give all four in {{count:plural; one:…; few:…; many:…; other:…;}}, e.g. 1 читатель, 2 читателя, 5 читателей; nouns and adjectives also change by case and gender, so avoid building sentences from fragments.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; never « копия ».

record.note: Catalogue entry of a title (« библиографическая запись »); « карточка » is the old paper-card word and is not used, to keep it apart from « читательский билет ».

patron.note: The standard word in Russian school libraries (« читатель », « формуляр читателя »). Plural « читатели » in the menu.

card.note: Short form « билет » where the context is clear.

loan.note: The action and the area (« Выдача »); an item on loan is « выдано »; the loan itself, as a record, « выдача ».

return.note: The action: « Возврат » on the menu, « вернуть » or « принять возврат » for the verb.

renew.note: Extending the due date; the only word used in Russian libraries.

overdue.note: Adjective « просроченный » (m.), « просроченная » (f.); of a person « должник ».

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return: « напоминание о возврате ».

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (« расстановочный шифр »), as in Russian libraries; « индекс » is used for the classification number only.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and шифр on the spine.

barcode.note: Written as one word; plural « штрихкоды ».

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

classification.note: The sorting scheme; Russian libraries use ББК and УДК, the program uses the Dewey-style scheme.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; the official library term is « проверка фондов »; « инвентаризация » is also used but also means the acquisitions register, so it is not used here.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have.

census.note: Registering the читатели with their photo.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year (« перевод в следующий класс » for one class).

anonymise.note: Perfective, for erasing the personal data for good; noun « обезличивание ».

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; short form « сканер ».

student.note: Feminine « ученица » only where the gender is known; the plain form is « ученик ».

teacher.note: Feminine « учительница » only where the gender is known; the plain form is « учитель ».

administration.note: The menu area; « администратор » for the person.

configuration.note: Use « настройки » for the settings area and « конфигурация » only in technical text (the configuration folder).

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled, as in Russian school libraries; the area as a whole is « Выдача ».
